1.

By wondrous ways He goes, In secret walks our God. In ocean’s depths His footprints are, And storm bears forth His word.

2.

With inexhaustible power’s might And wisdom deep beside, He brings to light from hidden veins, Almighty, what He wills.

3.

Ye saints, now take courage! The cloud your fear imparts Is filled with grace, and soon its flood Shall stream down over you.

4.

God’s purpose soon shall be revealed, And grace alone is there. Though bud’s taste bitter be, The fruit shall sweet yet be.

5.

Blind unbelief ever errs, When bold it would control God; But He His way shall make clear, And Himself interpret His word.
